metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
E4MOM x 4
250/200 m Row
12 Wall Balls — 9/6 kg
8 Burpees Over the Rower
Control on the row - unbroken wall balls &  send it on the last 4-8 burpees
Aim for +- 10 seconds between each round
score is the slowest round
Scale volume to get at least 60-90 seconds rest.

hypertrophy.reasoning: Deadlift and jerk dominate posterior chain and shoulders; accessory work targets pulling strength and chest to balance pressing volume.
